description:
Change a Quote Link that already exists. Takes the quote's manage_token and the COMPLETE new quote: every field of a quote, not only the changes. The customer link stays the same and now shows the new version, marked as updated. Earlier answers stay attached to the version they answered (an approval of version 1 shows as approved v1, quote since revised), and the customer can answer the new version.

Its prices are exactly the ones in the arguments. Every text field refuses links or web addresses, email addresses (except business.email) and payment details; customer.name is a display name only. Returns the new version number and its totals. Arguments that are not valid return errors, each naming the field, the problem and the fix.

addons.description: Optional. Extras the customer can tick on top of the option they pick (up to 10).

price.description: The add-on price as a plain number.

business.description: The user's own business, the one sending the quote. The customer sees these details marked as provided by the creator, not verified by Workeey.

email.description: Optional. The business's email address: the only field where an email address is allowed.

license.description: Optional. The business license number, as the user gives it.

name.description: Business name, shown as the heading of the quote.

phone.description: Optional. The business's phone number, written the way the user wants it shown.

currency.description: Optional. Three-letter ISO 4217 code of a currency with cents (2 decimals), like USD, CAD or EUR. Default USD. A currency without 2-decimal cents (JPY, KWD) isn't supported yet.

customer.description: Who the quote is for: a display name only. Never the customer's phone, email or address; quote links get shared and stay in chat history.

name.description: The name the customer sees on the quote, such as a first name.

deposit.description: Optional. Deposit wording shown on the quote: percent OR amount, and an optional note. Text only: Workeey takes no payments.

note.description: Optional. When the deposit is due. No links, email addresses or payment details (Zelle, Venmo, Cash App, PayPal, bank or card numbers, crypto).
examples: Due when the job is booked

percent.description: Deposit as a percent of the total.

exclusions.description: Optional. What the price does not include.

location.description: Optional. Where the job is: city and state only, never the customer's street address.

manage_token.description: The quote's private manage token: the long code after # in the private link (https://www.workeey.com/q/m/#<token>), returned as manage_token when the quote is created. The whole private link is accepted too. Required, unless your MCP client already sends it as an Authorization: Bearer header.

notes.description: Optional. Anything else the customer should know: what is included, timing, access. No links, email addresses or payment details (Zelle, Venmo, Cash App, PayPal, bank or card numbers, crypto).

options.description: The choices the customer picks between: 1 to 4 options (for example Standard and Premium), each priced on its own. A quote with a single price has one option. Workeey adds up every option, so send no totals.

description.description: Optional. What this option includes, or how it differs from the others.

items.description: The option's line items (1 to 50). The option's subtotal is the sum of quantity × unit_price.

unit_price.description: The price of one unit as a plain number with at most 2 decimals: 1450 or 2.1, never "$1,450" or "about 1.5k".

source.description: Optional. Which AI app is making this quote. Recorded as an unverified claim and never shown to the customer.

client.description: The name of your AI app.

tax.description: Optional. Tax exactly as the user supplies it: Workeey never decides tax rules. Send ONE of rate_percent (applied to the chosen option plus the chosen add-ons), amount (a fixed tax amount) or note (for example "Tax not included"). With no tax given, none is added.

label.description: Optional, with rate_percent or amount: what the tax is called.

note.description: A tax note instead of a number.

rate_percent.description: A tax rate in percent: 8.875 means 8.875%.

terms.description: Optional. The business's terms, such as warranty or cancellation. No links, email addresses or payment details (Zelle, Venmo, Cash App, PayPal, bank or card numbers, crypto).

title.description: The job, in a few words.

valid_until.description: Optional. The date the quote is valid until, YYYY-MM-DD. Default 30 days from today; at most 365 days ahead.

name: revise_quote_link
title: Revise a Quote Link
